restore.title: Restore from file
restore.consequence: Replaces all the library's data (books, shelves, loans, wishlist and covers) with the backup's. This cannot be undone.

signOut.title: Sign out of this device
signOut.consequence: To get back in you will need your email and password, or a new pairing code.

empty.title: No settings
empty.text: There are no settings available to you.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose the app colors. “System” follows the theme of your computer.

language.title: Language
language.description: “System” uses the language of your computer. The change is immediate.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.readOnly: Name and email cannot be changed from here.
profile.name: Name

password.title: Password
password.why: The password protects your access to the library from other devices.
password.whyLocal: This library is on your computer and needs no password to be used here. You need one if you share it over the network or invite other people: without a password they could not sign in with your account.
password.needsEmail: To set a password your account needs an email address first.
password.currentHint: Leave it empty if you have not set one yet.
password.savedHint: Your other devices will need to sign in again.

errors.tooShort: The password must have at least {min} characters.
errors.tooLong: The password can have at most {max} characters.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.

signOut.title: This device
signOut.description: Sign out of Bookeeper on this computer. Your books stay in the library.

library.title: Your library
library.readOnly: The library name cannot be changed from here.
library.name: Name

switch.title: Another library
switch.description: Sign out of this library to open another one or create a new one.

tls.proxy: Encrypted by a proxy, with a public address

phone.title: The phone needs a secure address
phone.text: To connect a phone the library must be reachable at a secure address. Set the address on the server, then add the phone from the Devices page.
phone.readyText: The library has a secure address: you can add a phone from the Devices page.
